item.title: SpaceX Q3 2026 results: Shares jump 8% in pre-market after $4.4 billion profit; what Musk said on SpaceX-Tesla merger

Revenue surged 161% to $14.58 billion, led by rapidly growing AI data-centre sales, while Starlink subscriber numbers also exceeded analysts’ expectations.
